headline: External sandbox pattern lets Claude Code, Codex and Pi run code in isolation
quote: Each of these implementations offers the same localhost API. You can then configure Pi, Claude Code, or Codex to send API calls to that sandbox
claim: Simon Willison and Prime Radiant released three sandbox server implementations (v86, Apple Containers, Quicksand) with one localhost API, plus an optional HTTP/HTTPS allow-list proxy and credential replacement.
why_it_matters: You can run a coding agent against local models without risking your laptop, and learn the sandbox pattern with working code.
title: External sandboxes for coding agents

headline: Claude Code lets /loop and scheduled tasks run 30 days
quote: Changed recurring scheduled tasks and /loop to run up to 30 days instead of 7 while their session keeps running
claim: The Claude Code changelog entry dated November 20, 2026 raises the limit for recurring scheduled tasks and /loop from 7 to 30 days while the session keeps running.
why_it_matters: Long-running recurring checks, like a daily repo or test watch, no longer lapse after a week.
title: Claude Code changelog - Claude Code Docs

headline: UK AISI has no legal power to compel model access
quote: AISI has no legal power to compel companies to share models, relying on the goodwill of frontier labs
claim: A Tech Policy Press commentary says the UK AI Security Institute relies on lab goodwill for pre-deployment access, and cites Politico reporting that the White House asked labs to withhold new models from AISI until US reviews finished; access was restored after 17 days.
why_it_matters: Shows how fragile government model testing is, and that open tools like AISI's Inspect evaluation framework are where students can contribute.
title: Britain’s AI Assurance Approach Needs a Second Act | TechPolicy.Press

headline: US midterm results may drive state data center and AI rules
quote: Newly elected governors and local ballot measures are likely to drive increased state and local regulation
claim: A law-firm briefing dated November 16, 2026 says new governors and ballot measures are likely to bring more state and local regulation, lengthening data center timelines; it flags Texas as a state to watch.
why_it_matters: US state rules shape where AI infrastructure gets built and which compliance rules products face.
title: How the Midterm Results Could Reshape AI and Data Center Regulations, and More Developments | Publications | Insights | Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP
